definitions.unit: Canonical repository URL, case-insensitive owner/name; multiple target packages and subprojects in the same repository count once.
definitions.declared: A target's exact registry identity or Git module URL appears in a downstream manifest, explicitly classified as runtime/dev/optional/peer/build/test and direct/transitive.
definitions.sourceIntegrated: A downstream non-example product source imports the identified package and calls its API on an application path. Import-only, generated scaffolds and dependency locks alone are insufficient.
definitions.runtimeExecuted: Requires separate execution/production evidence; source inspection alone cannot establish it.
definitions.unknown: Search failure, absent index entry, unsupported ecosystem or unavailable runtime evidence is null/unknown rather than zero.

searches.paginationReview: GitHub REST queries returned at most four files and no Link pagination; page 1 was sufficient for returned totals. Both own-repository calibration calls returned incomplete_results=true. Broad connector queries hit topn=100 and were not exhaustive.

limitations: No denominator of eligible external projects exists in this investigation; adoption percentage cannot be computed.
Public code search omitted the known upstream positive control; two REST control queries explicitly returned incomplete_results=true.
Connector provides ranked capped excerpts with no total/incomplete/pagination metadata. Broad aliases return unrelated text and cannot close coverage gaps.

Private repositories, non-GitHub source, unindexed/default-branch-excluded files, dynamic installation, one-off CLI/npx runs, vendored/renamed/copied implementations and actual runtime execution are not established.
Reverse-dependency indexes cover indexed published package relationships and can lag; zero graph rows do not establish zero application use.
No AI authorship, autonomous model choice, active users, retention or production execution is inferred from public source or graph metadata.

Unpublished source versions differ from registry versions: CLI manifest 0.4.0 vs npm latest 0.3.2, Python core manifest 0.2.0 vs PyPI latest 0.1.0. Searches used actual published identifiers and versions.
